articles.title: DC-DC Converter Selection Guide
articles.summary: Comprehensive guide for selecting DC-DC converters for various applications.
content: DC-DC converter selection requires consideration of input/output voltage, current, efficiency, and package constraints..

faeInsights.content: Proper DC-DC selection is critical for system efficiency.

faqs.question: How do I select a DC-DC converter?
faqs.answer: Consider voltage, current, efficiency, and thermal requirements.

articles.title: LDO Regulator Selection Guide
articles.summary: Guide for selecting LDO regulators based on noise, dropout, and PSRR requirements.
content: LDO selection requires understanding of noise requirements, dropout voltage, PSRR, and power dissipation..

faeInsights.content: LDO selection balances noise performance with power dissipation.

faqs.question: When should I use an LDO vs DC-DC?
faqs.answer: Use LDO for noise-sensitive apps with small voltage drop; use DC-DC for high efficiency with large drops.
